## Purpose

Runs Python tests against the cache sync service (test mode only).

## Dockerfile

`apps/tests/Dockerfile` — `python:3.12-slim`, installs sync's requirements. Prepares cache dir at `/var/lib/Wywy-Website/cache`. Command: `python manage.py test`.

## Docker Compose

Test-only in `docker-compose.test.yml`. Depends on `sync`, `create_tables` (completed), `database` (healthy). Mounts `apps/sync` as source.
